extension.description: Current health care expenditure measures the final consumption of health care goods and services. In this dataset it is presented classified by financing schemes (ICHA-HF), in accordance with the System of Health Accounts (SHA 2011) methodology. The dataset describes how consumption of health care goods and service is funded through, among others, government schemes, voluntary schemes and household out-of-pocket payments.
